description: This file defines the ReadableShippingSummary class, which represents a serializable data structure encapsulating shipping details such as costs, options, and related texts for a shopping/order context.

classes.name: ReadableShippingSummary
classes.description: A Java class that holds shipping summary details, including shipping costs, handling fees, shipping options, and related texts, equipped with getters and setters for serialization and data transfer.

methods.name: getShipping
methods.description: Returns the shipping cost as a BigDecimal.

methods.name: getHandling
methods.description: Returns the handling fee as a BigDecimal.

methods.name: isTaxOnShipping
methods.description: Indicates whether tax applies on shipping.

methods.name: getSerialversionuid
methods.description: Returns the serialVersionUID for serialization purposes.

methods.name: getShippingOptions
methods.description: Returns the list of available shipping options.

methods.name: setShippingOptions
methods.description: Sets the list of shipping options.

methods.name: getSelectedShippingOption
methods.description: Returns the currently selected shipping option.
